title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The changed code only adds a parameter check and raises an exception; no raw SQL is constructed or executed. All database interactions in the project use Django ORM elsewhere, and this diff does not introduce string‑concatenated queries.

findings.explanation: New URL patterns expose object‑edit, structure, and preview endpoints (e.g., `/object/<content_type_id>/edit/<object_id>/`). The diff does not add any permission or ownership checks before routing to `render_object_edit` etc., so a user could potentially access or modify objects they do not own (IDOR) unless the view functions enforce authorization internally.

findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit permission checks (e.g., verify the requesting user has edit rights on the target object) before invoking the render_object_* views, or ensure those view functions perform strict ownership/role validation.
